about.title: About
about.lead: Most delivery problems start at the handoffs: unclear ownership, slow decisions, and manual work that keeps coming back. I make those workflows visible, owned, and easier to run.
about.approach: I map how the work really moves, give every step an owner, and automate what keeps coming back. A background in engineering and QA lets me scope work and make trade-offs with developers; AI takes the triage, drafts and summaries so the team stays on the hard problems.
about.proofWork: Three case studies with results: a sold-out conference for 1,000+ attendees, an AI-assisted platform for nursing homes, and onboarding automation that saves ~{minutes} minutes on every hire.
about.proofEngineering: Hands-on engineering: deployments, technical challenges and practice projects, with code you can open.
about.proofReferences: Recommendations from directors, a CEO and teammates at the companies I've worked with.
